articles.summary: Rinsed has released its latest quarterly car wash industry report, compiling data from the last five quarters to help operators compare their car wash’s performance to broader industry trends.
articles.title: New Quarterly Car Wash Industry Report by Rinsed Is Live

articles.summary: Rinsed has launched a new AI-powered phone support agent, built for car washes. This new product works alongside CRM to help reduce time restraints on your team, increase efficiency and provide an optimal customer experience, no matter the time of day or volume of calls.
articles.title: Rinsed Launches AI Phone Support for Car Washes
